newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya's president mediates between Uganda, Sudan.
newsitem.headline: Kenya's president mediates between Uganda, Sudan.

text.p: Kenya's President Daniel arap Moi hosted talks on Saturday between the presidents of Uganda and Sudan in a bid to resolve their deep differences, officials said.

The official Presidential Press Unit quoted Moi as saying in the western Kenyan town of Eldoret that he hoped Uganda and Sudan would reach an amicable solution to their problems because the region needed development instead of conflict.
Moi also called a meeting of a subcommittee comprising Kenya, Uganda, Eritrea and Ethiopia of the Inter-Governmental Authority on Development (IGAD) to help end civil war in south Sudan.

Moi, who first held separate talks with Ugandan President Yoweri Museveni and Sudanese President Lieutenant-General Omar Hassan al-Bashir, said he hoped their meeting on Saturday would be a firm beginning towards trust between the IGAD countries.

Uganda accuses the Sudanese government of arming and giving bases in south Sudan to Ugandan rebels of the Lord's Resistance Army. Sudan accuses Uganda of arming and supporting the rebel Sudan People's Liberation Army (SPLA) led by John Garang.

The SPLA has fought since 1983 for greater autonomy of the Christian and animist south from the Moslem, Arabised north and has scored its biggest success since 1991 with a series of offensives this year.
The LRA has been severely weakened by the strength of the SPLA in the south but Garang denies he is fighting for Uganda.
Uganda last month said its army killed 60 Sudanese soldiers and captured more than 100 just inside northern Uganda, beating back a joint attack by the Sudanese army and Ugandan rebels.
It displayed what it said were 114 captured Sudanese soldiers and 16 Ugandan rebels state-run radio said had fled into Uganda to escape attacks by the SPLA in southern Sudan.

At about the same time last month, Sudan displayed several men it said were Ugandan prisoners of war captured after a battle with the Sudanese army in south Sudan. Uganda denies sending its own troops to fight alongside the SPLA rebels.
